## Description

Runs [`cloc`](https://github.com/AlDanial/cloc) over the deposit to count lines of code and comments per language. In `1-populate-from-icpsr` it runs in the `aldanial/cloc` image; `w-big-populate-from-icpsr` installs `cloc` first. When `cloc` is missing, the script exits with an error.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/08_count_lines.sh <directory> [tag]
```

- `directory` - Deposit directory. When it does not exist but `cache/$projectID.zip` does, `cloc` reads the ZIP instead (`projectID` from the environment).
- `tag` - Optional suffix for the output names.

## Outputs

- `generated/linecount[.tag].txt`, `generated/linecount[.tag].md`, `generated/linecount[.tag].csv`
